Class Move

java.lang.Object
com.splendor.model.Move
public class Move extends Object
Represents a move made by a player during their turn. Contains the move type and any associated data such as selected gems or cards.

  • Method Details

    • reserveFromDeck

      public static Move reserveFromDeck(int tier)
      Factory method for a blind deck-reserve move. The resulting Move has no cardId (the specific card is unknown until drawn) and carries the deck tier so the board knows which pile to draw from.
      Parameters:
      tier - The deck tier to draw from (1, 2, or 3).
      Returns:
      A RESERVE_CARD Move targeting a face-down deck card.
